description: This Java class 'ClientMapper' provides methods to convert between 'Client' entity objects and 'ClientDto' data transfer objects, facilitating data mapping in a Spring application.

classes.name: ClientMapper
classes.description: A Spring component class responsible for mapping between Client entity and ClientDto.

methods.name: toDto
methods.description: Converts a Client entity to a ClientDto object by copying relevant fields.

methods.name: toEntity
methods.description: Converts a ClientDto object to a Client entity, constructing associated objects and retrieving user data via UserService.
